delta: AUG 25: 10Y fell over 7bps to 4.625% as markets rotated into chip stocks ahead of Nvidia earnings and looked past the Canada tariff escalation.
deltaNote: JULY 23-AUG 25 ARC: The Red Sea/Hormuz oil shock (Brent >$100, July 23) pushed yields to a multi-month high as September Fed-hike odds jumped to ~82%. The Aug 7 jobs report and Aug 12-13 CPI/PPI prints both cooled, pulling the 10Y down to 4.65% and September hike odds under 35%. The Aug 14 Hormuz tanker attacks and the Aug 17 expiration of the US-Iran MOU then pushed the 30-year Treasury yield to 5.31-5.32% — its highest level since June 2007. Yields have since eased again: 10Y at 4.625% on Aug 25, even as the US-Canada trade war escalated (Section 338 tariffs took effect Aug 22; Canada's retaliatory tariffs announced Aug 25, effective Sept 8) — underlying debt/inflation concerns remain the structural floor under long-end yields.
